quiz.question.text: In the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939), which side do you sympathize with more: the Republicans (Loyalists, Second Spanish Republic, International Brigades, etc.) or the Nationalists (Franco, Falangists, etc.)?
quiz.toll.communist.label: people killed worldwide by communist regimes
quiz.toll.communist.note: Scholars' estimates run from about 20 million to over 100 million, most of them the regimes' own citizens, many through executions, labour camps and famine. Sources: Benjamin Valentino, Final Solutions (2005); Stéphane Courtois and others, The Black Book of Communism (1997).
quiz.toll.fascist.label: people killed worldwide by fascist and Nazi regimes
quiz.toll.fascist.note: Including 6 million Jews in the Holocaust, during a world war that killed 70 to 85 million people. Source: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum.
